scope: Every one of 1086 current registry entries and every one of 87 material hubs; reviewed molecular graphs only. No rereading or additional paper curation.
scientific_qualifications: Computed conformers are reference illustrations, not measured molecular structures, unique solution species, surface geometry or nanocrystal training coordinates.
Salt components are displayed independently; no bonds were cut or added to create coordination geometries, and atomic counterions remain in the retained composition drawing.
Source-unassigned stereoisomer mixtures, abbreviated R-group graphs, unresolved identities, bulk solids, polymers and specimen/equipment contexts remain qualified exceptions.
HMPT in Song is tris(dimethylamino)phosphine C6H18N3P (PubChem 15355), not C6H12N3P or PTA.
Selenium/phosphine conformers with missing force-field parameters are explicitly labeled unminimized ETKDG reference geometry.
browser_expectations: Song HMPT and HMPT chalcogenide buttons open 3D canvas with drag/zoom/reset, no atom labels; element legend outside.
Zinc nitrate hexahydrate keeps formal composition image, with separate Rotate nitrate and Rotate water component buttons; no Zn-O bonds or ion arrangement.
Existing CdSe TOP/TOPO viewers remain unchanged.
Unknown mixtures and solid products keep honest composition/context references rather than fabricated molecules.
final_scope_delta: Nine formula/mixture identities expose separately qualified component references. No complete reagent or unknown solution speciation is reconstructed.
independent_review: Passed geometry/identity checks and nine-entry qualification follow-up; browser/release completion recorded separately.
